title: Federal Rule 17 — parties and capacity
summary: The real party in interest is the person entitled under the governing substantive law to enforce the right asserted. The inquiry can change when rights are assigned or an insurer becomes subrogated to a claim.

sections.Role in the course: The real party in interest is the person entitled under the governing substantive law to enforce the right asserted. The inquiry can change when rights are assigned or an insurer becomes subrogated to a claim.
sections.What to examine: Identify the underlying right and any transfer or payment affecting who owns it. Distinguish full subrogation from partial payment. Then apply the governing procedural rule about the name in which the action proceeds and any opportunity to cure.
